answer_1.quote: We perceive a parallel between this process and combining ingredients to create a complete dish. In particular,  have shown that combining lexical morphemes yields optimal parsing for generating Korean sentences.
answer_1.outputs: The morpheme blender employs the lexical morphemes and generates the new synthetic sentence by leveraging the knowledge of derivational and inflectional rules in conjunction with functional morphemes obtained from a pre-trained generative model.

answer_2.quote: Accuracy (Acc.), F1-score (F1), and Pearson correlation (Pearsonr) are used as evaluation metrics.
